run_align_lid_to_wiki: run the script to align language IDs to Wikipedia language codes and dump metadata
run_wiki_to_lid_mapping: run the script to build a reverse mapping from Wikipedia codes to language IDs
run_merge_wiki_codes: run the script to merge Wikipedia language codes by splitting on underscores
run_dump_wiki_metadata: run the script to dump valid Wikipedia metadata as JSON and pickle automata
run_build_automaton: run the script to build and pickle an Aho-Corasick automaton for substring matching
